summary: Patria Investments Limited, a Cayman-domiciled alternative asset manager listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K containing Exhibit 99.1, its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. No transaction, board recommendation, stake, or price is disclosed. The balance sheet shows total assets of $1.83bn versus $1.50bn at year-end 2025, with intangible assets up to $1.06bn from $824m and non-controlling interests rising to $75m, consistent with prior acquisitions captured through consideration payable and put-option obligations. Routine financial reporting; no risk-arb angle applies.
